description: This PHP file is a template rendering a blog post widget, displaying post image, title, subtitle, author, and links within a channel's blog.

classes.name: Post
classes.description: Represents a blog post, providing access to attributes like header image, title, subtitle, publication date, slug, and author.

classes.name: Author
classes.description: Represents the author of a blog post, providing access to author's name.

methods.name: getSlug
methods.description: Returns the URL slug identifier for the post.

methods.name: getAuthor
methods.description: Retrieves the author object of the post.

methods.name: header_image
methods.description: Property holding the post's header image.
